data.content_ref: inline:The problem explicitly requires 'Drawing on published definitions' and even provides a directed-fetch mechanism (allowlisted to docs.python.org) to obtain citable evidence blocks. SRC_001 provides a purely conceptual distinction between idempotency and safety without citing, naming, referencing, or proposing to fetch any published definition. It neither identifies a source (e.g., a standards document, API contract, or academic reference) nor proposes any https fetch to docs.python.org. This is a direct failure of the problem's standard as stated: the target answers the distinction question from first principles rather than from published definitions.
